newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 4.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on October 4:
WASHINGTON - Congress finds $12 million for District to repair its dilapidated schools without adding to the federal deficit.
WASHINGTON - Revlon Inc. has announced plans to merge its cosmetics stores with Cosmetic Center Inc. of Savage, Maryland.
WASHINGTON - The Washington metropolitan area's unemployment rate improved in August to the lowest level in five months, dipping to 3.7 percent.
WASHINGTON - There are red faces at Bell Atlantic Corp. over the company's new suburban Yellow Pages. The telephone company has listed the wrong number for its own Yellow Pages advertising.
